standard_prerequisites.name: The definition of a catenary space through equality of dimensions of maximal chains
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 1797-1810)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces catenarity to the equality of the dimensions of two chains.

core_obligations: Reduce to a comparison of two chains: catenarity is the statement that the two dimensions of a pair of comparable irreducible closed subsets add up as expected, so it suffices to compare the chains filling a given interval (proof lines 1796-1812)
Use the fixed codimension hypothesis: insert the intermediate members of a chain of the prescribed codimension and compare lengths to get the asserted equality (proof lines 1813-1827)
proof_roadmap: 把 catenary 性质写成「对可比较的两点，维数相加等于维数」；只需比较填充同一区间的链。
由固定余维数的链假设，插入中间项比较长度，得所需等式。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a space is catenary as soon as chains of a fixed codimension behave as expected (author lemma at source lines 1782-1794, label lemma-catenary-in-codimension). The proof (source lines 1796-1828) reduces catenarity to a comparison of the dimensions of a pair of comparable closed subsets and inserts the intermediate members of a chain of the prescribed codimension to obtain the equality (proof lines 1796-1827). The reduction to chain comparison is the content. H3.
